notes: New: Lessons (Learn → Lessons). A path of 36 short lessons in 6 units, from your first checkmate to mating patterns: Basics, Tactics, Endgames, Openings, Tactics II and Mating patterns.
Each lesson shows the idea on a real game, then 4 exercises with instant feedback, hints and stars. Your rating places you, and a Test out quiz can skip a unit.
A lesson for your weak spot is recommended and added to Today's plan. Positions you miss go into Memory. Lessons also work on the phone page and sync.
